name: lw_23175
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hab : a + b + c = 3) : 6 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * a ^ 2 + b * c + 1) + Real.sqrt (2 * b ^ 2 + c * a + 1) + Real.sqrt (2 * c ^ 2 + a * b + 1)
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hab : a + b + c = 3), 6 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * a ^ 2 + b * c + 1) + Real.sqrt (2 * b ^ 2 + c * a + 1) + Real.sqrt (2 * c ^ 2 + a * b + 1)
informal: If $a,b,c$ are nonnegative real numbers such that $a+b+c=3,$ then \n $ \sqrt{2a^2+bc+1}+\sqrt{2b^2+ca+1}+\sqrt{2c^2+ab+1} \geq 6.$
